map.Pong 乒乓游戏 使用指南: Pong Table Tennis Game User Guide
map.双方用挡板接住来回的球，漏接对方得分；先达到目标分（默认 11 分，可设）者胜。: Both players use the paddle to return the ball, and a miss scores for the opponent; the first to the target score (default 11, configurable) wins. Ball speed rises slightly with rally count and AI difficulty is adjustable.
map.双人对战：同屏左右挡板，接球对打。: Two-player battle: paddles on both sides of one screen, hit the ball back and forth.
map.AI 模式：单人挑战电脑，难度可调。: AI mode: a single player challenges the computer with adjustable difficulty.
map.休闲竞技：先得目标分（默认 11）者胜。: Casual competitive play: the first to the target score (default 11) wins.
map.目标分固定 11 吗？: Is the Target Score Fixed at 11?
map.默认 11，可调；正式乒乓比赛也是 11 分制（领先 2 分胜）。: Default 11 and adjustable; official table tennis also uses 11 points (win by 2).
map.怎么打赢 AI？: How Do I Beat the AI?
map.用挡板边缘接球改变球路，逼 AI 够不到；AI 弱时直接对拉消耗。: Use the paddle edge to change the ball's path so the AI cannot reach it; when the AI is weak, just trade rallies to wear it down.
